findings.claim: IsPublicReadWrite treats public fields as eligible only when field.IsReadOnly is true (inverted). Writable public fields are skipped, and readonly fields are marked IsWritable: true. The generated deserializer then assigns to readonly fields, so the generated formatter will fail to compile (CS0191) or the contractless contract will silently drop data. The inversion is not a security issue by itself, but it is a correctness defect in deserialization of untrusted data shape.

receipt_plan.detail: Generator snapshot test: [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] partial class for a type with `public int Field;` and `public readonly int RO;`. Expect Field serialized and RO excluded; the test fails: Field is dropped and RO produces a compile error.

findings.claim: In contractless mode, string-key members are sorted by name and given an IntKey of their index, but isIntKey=false. That is fine, but surrogate int keys with gaps (e.g. 0 and 1000) pass an attacker-irrelevant but unbounded IntKey into the array-layout templates. The array-header size is derived from the max key, so a very large [Key(int.MaxValue)] on a surrogate would make generated code allocate or write a huge array header. Deserialization of an array of that declared length then loops over attacker-supplied header counts; the existing MessagePackSecurity and collection checks do not apply to the generated object formatter's header count.

receipt_plan.detail: Snapshot test: surrogate with [Key(0)] and [Key(100000)]. Inspect the generated Serialize writing an array header of 100001 nil elements, and compare with the existing [MessagePackObject] behaviour.

findings.claim: The generated formatter model is built by the generator with reportDiagnostic: null, and failures return null silently. A separate diagnostics pipeline re-runs Collect. If ReferenceSymbols.TryCreate fails, no diagnostic is reported, and the formatter is silently not generated. The user-declared partial class then fails to implement IMessagePackFormatter<T> with only a generic compiler error. This is not a security protection being disabled, only a degraded diagnostic.

receipt_plan.detail: Read the generatedFormatterDiagnostics SelectMany: when ReferenceSymbols.TryCreate returns false, it emits an empty array.
